title: ReMC+
description: A vanilla+ modpack to enhance your playing experience while keeping the game's original feeling
body:
This well optimized modpack give you an all new way to play Minecraft while keeping the vanilla feel of this beautifull game. With featured mod and texture pack like xaeros minimap, geophilic or just enough item for the mod and fresh animations and icons for the texture pack.
If you like playing minecraft while giving you a new experience this modpack is for you
